coverage_notes: This release does not add an OpenGauss Java live scenario because no stable representative public fixture is available.
OpenGauss catalog capture and disposition behavior is covered by deterministic kernel fixtures and tests; this file does not claim a live database evaluation.

evals.name: cli-contract-e2e
evals.prompt: (no LLM) run_cli_e2e.py exercises the fixed Artifact loop, split Plan narrative/ledger, bounded evidence and page packets, Domain/Concept/source-area closure, derived code model units, Plan and Composition review gates, thick Domain projections without duplicate ownership, authored-page routing, late link binding, deterministic navigation and atomic Publication
evals.expected_output: passed true; exit 0 on Windows, Linux and macOS; Windows stdout parses through ConvertFrom-Json

evals.name: killbill-finance-multi-repository
evals.prompt: Run run_live_eval.py with --scenario killbill as an opt-in high-cost domain-recall and bundle-review QA run.
evals.fixture: setup_java_ws.py --scenario killbill (four fixed Kill Bill revisions)
evals.expected_output: published thin wiki connecting billing domains across API, implementation, commons and platform repositories
assertions: one long-lived planner integrates all four Sources
focused evidence workers return notes and each independent page writer receives one kernel-derived bounded page packet
an independent digest-bound Plan review approves domain recall before Composition
the readable Plan narrative and strict Plan ledger are separately validated and bound by one review digest
Plan closes every Source, Domain and Concept, assigns explicit definition owners and derives persistent model owner units
each Concept declares opengauss, code or none model basis with matching evidence and coverage gaps
every selected Catalog table has exactly one resolved disposition when a captured Catalog is present
Plan closes every scoped Source with a seed and integration units name producer and consumer roles
Plan and Composition reviews record merge probes covering every routed item
Plan routes the scenario's enterprise change intents and covers or explicitly gaps the invoice/payment/overdue feedback bridge
Plan uses cohesive routable units without imposing a fixed unit count
an independent digest-bound Composition review approves task routing before page fan-out
Domain page packets project model, state/lifecycle and flow routes without duplicating unit ownership
Composition maps Domain and Concept definition owners and every persistent model owner to the required authored Page Type
Composition routes the Kill Bill intents across cohesive capability-oriented pages instead of imposing a fixed page count or mirroring Maven modules
generated Schema and Table references are excluded from authored drafts and merge-probe coverage while remaining in Candidate review and Publication
the reviewed Candidate contains root and capability Navigation Indexes before Publication
Composition review rejects both unrelated bundling and mechanical one-unit-per-page fan-out
the final Wiki carries every routed intent in page metadata and evidence-backed prose
Chinese runs use the Chinese template set and localize title, description, prose and diagram routing text
each review reports all independently supportable issues in one pass and retains stable issue IDs as resolved history
final Wiki review checks unit mapping, evidence, split, merge and move defects without repeating repository-wide discovery
repairs return to the same reviewer for digest-bound focused follow-up
published validation reports complete true with zero errors, or names skipped checks when prerequisites are missing
published navigation connects all four repositories
trace reports status calls and stays within internal-access, tool-output and recovery budgets
